text:
claire: Heads-up: ran the Next starter that demonstrates LangChain + eval harness and noticed three onboarding problems: missing embed telemetry, flaky auth after rotate, and the eval harness flagging duplicate outputs. Anyone else hit this combo?
ben: Yep. Repro steps: clone, pnpm install, set RW_KEY, start dev, run /api/eval. Embeds don't appear in the dev console and occasionally the first few requests after calling /api/rotate-token return 401 before retries succeed.
ash: I traced the embed issue: example creates the embeddings client at module import with a fixed key. That means the eval harness (which posts a rotate signal) uses the stale instance. Changing to a per-request factory fixes telemetry immediately.
jorge: Duplicate output case: we saw two POSTs to /generate for a single agent.run when network latency caused the SDK retry logic to kick in. The starter doesn't set idempotency headers so the server executes twice and the harness sees different diffs.
claire: So three things: (1) make embed client per-request or use tokenProvider; (2) ensure SDK reads latest token on each request (tokenProvider or recreate client); (3) add idempotency header or change retry policy for starter.
ben: I'll open a tiny PR for the starter that (a) moves client construction into the handler, (b) calls telemetry.emit("embedding.created") after embed call, and (c) documents the short-term workaround.
nash: I'll work on an SDK patch that optionally accepts `tokenProvider: () => string | Promise<string>` so long-running instances can refresh tokens without re-instantiation. I'll add unit tests that call rotate-token and assert no 401 spike.
jorge: For idempotency, proposing a small helper `getIdempotencyKey(req)` that sets `x-rw-idempotency` and add it into the example. Also change retry middleware to avoid retrying for 4xx unless the transport error indicates no server processing. I'll PR a minimal version to the starter to keep onboarding friction low.
ci-bot: created issue DE-701: "next-langchain-eval-starter: embeds not instrumented, stale token on rotation, duplicate model calls from retries" assigned @ben @nash @jorge.
claire: Workarounds to add to README: recreate client per-request, set RW_TELEMETRY_OPT_IN to opt-in for session linkage, and use RW_RETRY_MODE=conservative to avoid duplicate billing while we patch.
ben: PR #321 opened for starter doc + per-request client + telemetry event. Includes a unit that asserts telemetry called for embeds.
nash: WIP branch for tokenProvider, adding integration test to the eval harness that simulates rotate -> run -> expect zero 401s. Will run on node 18/20 matrix in GH actions.
jorge: PR for idempotency helper ready as draft. It includes a tiny harness e2e that ensures a single /generate call is recorded when server returns 429 then 200.
claire: Once merged, cherry-pick into the quickstart templates so new users don't hit it. Also include a short blurb in release notes to surface the change.
ben: Thanks team. I'll follow up with links to PRs & CI when green.
ci-bot: linked DE-701 to onboarding board and labeled needs-e2e.
claire: Appreciate the quick turnaround on this ":thumbsup:". Closing once all three PRs are merged and the starter in get-started is updated.
